name: diag_train_look710298_terminal_check_01
command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
from src.envs import pair_v2_terminal as terminal
from src.envs import pair_v2_raw_sampling as sampling
r=Path.cwd().resolve();n='gen_train_look_first_unit_01_retry2'
parent,pref=audited_result(r/'results'/(n+'.json'))
child,cref=audited_result(r/'results'/(n+'_c6_floorplan315.json'))
account,aref=audited_result(r/'results/diag_train_look710298_accounting_01.json')
m=child['metrics'];c=child['config']
assert child['_meta']['exit_code']==parent['_meta']['exit_code']==1 and account['_meta']['exit_code']==0
assert c['scene']=='FloorPlan315' and c['shard']['pbs_jobid']=='710298.hopper-m-02'
assert parent['config']['scene_timeout_seconds']==1200 and parent['config']['timeout_seconds']==1600
assert len(parent['metrics']['scene_runs'])==1 and parent['metrics']['scene_runs'][0]['granted_timeout_seconds']==1200
assert all(parent['metrics']['scene_runs'][0]['source'][k]==cref[k] for k in ['file','sha256','metrics_sha256'])
sampling.validate_fields(c);sampling.validate_fields(m)
journal=terminal.checked_journal(m,c,r)
assert journal==m['terminal_receipt']['journal'] and m['terminal_receipt']['generator_returned_after_cleanup'] is True
assert m['final_metrics_verified'] is True and m['terminal_verified_after_cleanup'] is True
assert m['cleanup_errors']==parent['metrics']['cleanup_errors']==[]
admission=m['g01_witness_admission']
assert admission['cleanup_confirmed'] is True and admission['active_leases']==admission['errors']==[]
assert all(v['release_confirmed'] is True and v['remaining_owned_group'] is False and v['cleanup_errors']==[] for v in admission['lease_records'])
print('ORIGINAL_TERMINAL_FIELDS_JSON: '+json.dumps({'sources':[pref,cref,aref],'parent_status':parent['metrics']['status'],'parent_exit_code':parent['_meta']['exit_code'],'child_status':m['status'],'child_exit_code':child['_meta']['exit_code'],'original_error':m.get('error'),'reported_counts':{k:m[k] for k in ['attempts','passed_by_class','discard_reason_counts','nearby_physics_counts']},'checked_journal':journal,'cleanup_errors':m['cleanup_errors'],'worker_failed':m['status']=='worker_failed','final_metrics_verified':m['final_metrics_verified'],'terminal_verified_after_cleanup':m['terminal_verified_after_cleanup'],'raw_sampling_version':m['raw_sampling_version'],'raw_sampling_policy':m['raw_sampling_policy'],'raw_saving_stopped':m['search_raw_storage']['raw_saving_stopped'],'raw_cap_events':m['search_raw_storage']['cap_events'],'allocation':account['metrics'],'engineering_pass_claimed':False,'scope':'Original formal1200-second source remains exit1/incomplete; not relabeled as the distinct600-second smoke or independent pair acceptance'},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
